newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Bogota stocks close down led by Bavaria.
newsitem.headline: Bogota stocks close down led by Bavaria.

text.p: Colombian stocks closed down in trading that saw brewing giant Bavaria slip on what brokers described as a sudden influx of its shares.

Medellin's IBOMED .IBMG general price index dipped 0.28 percent to 18,229.56 on above-average trading volume of 4.8 billion pesos. Bogota's IBB .IBB index edged down a slim 0.03 percent to 1,199.43 on volume of about 2.5 billion pesos.

Bavaria, flagship of the Julio Mario Santo Domingo conglomerate, fell 0.31 percent to 7,950 pesos a share on 393 million pesos in Bogota. It edged down 0.18 percent in Medellin, to close at 7.980 on trade of some 1.4 billion pesos.
Traders said two large brokerage houses had flooded the market with shares of Bavaria to keep the price down.

Bank Bancoquia, recently renamed Banco Santander Colombia, rose 0.64 percent to 3,121 pesos per share on trade of 90 million in Bogota and up 1.77 percent at 3,150 on volume of 19 million pesos in Medellin.
Traders said Bancoquia rebounded on the expectation that Grupo Santander de Espana will soon complete a $146 million deal to purchase a 55 percent stake in the bank from Bavaria.
